items.title_en: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
items.summary_en: Oman said positive talks have been taking place with Iran over an agreement to secure a shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, through which around a fifth of the world's oil and natural gas usually flows. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said negotiations were in their final stages, but warned that reopening the strait remained subject to other conditions, including compensation from the US. Oman also warned against attacks on shipping, after the UAE said an Iranian missile had struck one of its tankers.
items.title_zh: 阿曼稱荷莫茲海峽談判樂觀 伊朗警告達成協議不代表立即重啟航道
items.summary_zh: 阿曼表示，與伊朗就確保荷莫茲海峽航運路線的協議已進行正面磋商；全球約五分之一的石油與天然氣通常經由此海峽運輸。伊朗外長阿拉格齊表示談判已進入最後階段，但警告海峽重新開放仍取決於其他條件，包括美國須提供賠償。阿曼同時警告勿攻擊海峽船隻，此前阿聯酋指控一枚伊朗飛彈擊中其國營石油公司的油輪。

items.title_en: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
items.summary_en: Typhoon Dolphin cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured at least five people after hitting Japan's Okinawa island on Saturday, with maximum wind speeds of 162km/h. Flights were cancelled as Naha International Airport closed, and the storm is expected to make landfall on China's eastern coast late on Sunday or early Monday, where authorities have shut ports and schools ahead of its arrival.
items.title_zh: 颱風「海豚」重創日本沖繩 接著撲向中國東部沿海
items.summary_zh: 颱風「海豚」週六侵襲日本沖繩，最大風速達每小時162公里，造成至少4萬4千棟建築停電、至少5人受傷。那霸國際機場關閉導致航班取消；颱風預計於週日深夜至週一凌晨在中國東部沿海登陸，當地已提前關閉港口與學校，浙江沿海颱風警報並已升至最高等級。

items.title_en: Trump administration moves ahead with efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
items.summary_en: The Trump administration is moving ahead with its efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, two months after the Supreme Court allowed her to retain her job while she fights the president's effort to terminate her over mortgage fraud allegations she has denied. The renewed push escalates an unprecedented fight over the central bank's independence, which financial markets around the world watch closely.
items.title_zh: 川普政府再度推動開除聯準會理事庫克 央行獨立性之爭升溫
items.summary_zh: 川普政府重啟開除聯準會理事麗莎·庫克的行動。兩個月前最高法院以5比4裁定，在她就遭解職提起的訴訟進行期間可保住職位；庫克否認川普方面指控的房貸詐欺行為。此番再度出手使圍繞央行獨立性的空前角力進一步升級，全球金融市場正密切關注聯準會的利率動向。

items.title_en: Dodgers lose season-high 7th straight as Diamondbacks walk off against Edwin Diaz
items.summary_en: The Los Angeles Dodgers lost their season-high seventh game in a row after the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied for a 4-3 win, when rookie Ryan Waldschmidt hit a two-run, walk-off homer against closer Edwin Diaz. The two-time defending World Series champions still hold a comfortable lead in the National League West, despite a 10-16 record since July 5.
items.title_zh: 道奇遭再見轟苦吞7連敗 終結者戴亞茲被新秀轟出致命兩分砲
items.summary_zh: 洛杉磯道奇吞下本季最長的7連敗：響尾蛇新秀沃德施密特從終結者艾德溫·戴亞茲手中擊出兩分再見全壘打，助隊以4比3逆轉獲勝。儘管7月5日以來戰績僅10勝16敗，這支尋求三連霸的世界大賽衛冕軍在國聯西區仍保有7.5場的安全領先。
